def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    N = int(data[0])
    T = int(data[1])
    
    A = [int(data[i*2 + 2]) - 1 for i in range(T)]  # Convert to 0-indexed
    B = [int(data[i*2 + 3]) for i in range(T)]
    
    scores = [0] * N
    unique_scores = {0}
    results = []
    
    for i in range(T):
        player = A[i]
        increment = B[i]
        
        # Record old score
        old_score = scores[player]
        
        # Update the score of the player
        scores[player] += increment
        
        # If the old score was in the unique set, remove it (if it's no longer present)
        if old_score in unique_scores:
            unique_scores.remove(old_score)
            
        # Add the new score to the unique set
        new_score = scores[player]
        unique_scores.add(new_score)
        
        # Count occurrences of each score to keep track
        score_count = {s: scores.count(s) for s in unique_scores}
        
        # Restore the uniqueness condition, in case old_score was the last instance
        # Remove the old unique if its count goes to zero
        if score_count[old_score] == 0:
            unique_scores.remove(old_score)
        
        # Append the size of the unique scores set
        results.append(len(unique_scores))
    
    for result in results:
        print(result)

main()
